verdict.rationale: Ledgy offers an API with cap table and transaction data retrieval (companyCaptable, companyTransactions) and mentions custom exports/reports, suggesting data can be extracted programmatically, but there's no documented bulk 'export all data' feature, no stated open format (CSV/JSON schema) guarantee, and no explicit data-portability/account-closure export flow. missing for 10: explicit full-account data export capability, documented open format specification, evidence of a one-click 'export everything and leave' feature, independent confirmation of completeness.
